No hands or held objects are needed; keep a clean avatar silhouette.
Draw in refined genuinely TWO-DIMENSIONAL anime linework with a softly hand-painted gouache/pencil sensibility that belongs beside the supplied literary room. Natural soft window light from upper left gives a faint warm edge to gray hair and a quiet cool reflected plane; skin remains fresh and naturally colored, never wax, plastic, photoreal pores or 3D smooth shading. Use a few readable hair groups with restrained fine accents, not a tangle of high-frequency strands. Eyes and mouth remain legible at small UI-avatar size. Do not imitate an artist name or official model-material finish.
True transparency surrounding the complete new bust, with clean hair tips/shoulder edges. No circular disk, medallion, frame, gradient background, white/black rectangle, fake checkerboard, room crop, vignette, glow, fog, drop shadow, text, title, badge, speech bubble, watermark or collage. One complete original standalone 2D human avatar only.
